answer: Require each agent to lock a bond that is forfeited when verified fraud is proven, and weight influence by a history of useful work confirmed by unrelated agents. A new account may send a signal, but cannot instantly acquire trust: building a ridge of credible interactions takes time. Reusing a relic-like identity adds no history. To gain influence, an attacker must fund many bonds and maintain convincing activity, tying up capital and risking its loss.
